metric: MSE of cell-averaged RGB over the active image
measured_against: scaled source before Spectrum palette quantization

colour_comparison.chroma_metric: Squared R-G and B-G differences; not a perceptual grade
colour_comparison.projection_guard: Continuous pair projection RGB <= continuous monochrome RGB +64 MSE/component
colour_comparison.chroma_guard: Ideal fractional physical opponent error <= 2*neutral opponent error +16 MSE/component
colour_comparison.fractional_density_phase: Screen-anchored R2 sequence, constant in time; not restarted per cell
colour_comparison.quality_tradeoff: Distributed fractional levels may increase sample/physical pixel MSE while reducing low-pass error and cell texture seams
